why: A runner comes out of the side gate, but CRISIS is Siege: gates closed (C0010), nothing goes in or out by gate or road
Looms clatter shutter to shutter as ordinary work; under Siege+Famine field work and trade have stopped (C0101)
Money changer trading coins from many mints as usual; siege closes roads and trade, C0066 says effective trade near zero
Economic Resilience Strong contradicts Prosperity Struggling, viable False, and Economic capacity Strained (C0149)
Plural power name 'Religious Authorities' with singular verb 'gains'; subject and verb disagree
Plural 'Grain Holders' with singular verb 'loses'; subject-verb disagreement
Slash roster label 'Military/Guard' used as a power's name beside a verb
Slash label 'Military/Guard' used as a power's name beside a verb
Smuggling network moving something that will 'arrive' this week; under Siege nothing comes in or out by road, gate or water
Vintner lacks access to grapes (LAND gaps) and imports are cut by siege, yet the row offers Table wine with no short mark, unlike Potter/Brickmaker
Butchers row offers Fresh meat unmarked under Famine, yet the Services tab marks Fresh meat Impaired
Daily markets offer Fresh produce and General trade unmarked; Siege stops trade and Famine means food is short (C0134)
Fish 'come in by cart' and Preserved fish unmarked; under Siege nothing comes in by road (C0068), and Famine
Stone quarry row offers Cut stone and rubble unmarked; LAND gives Stone quarry as depleted and TRADE imports dressed stone
Contraband transport: goods move past checkpoints, routes run; contradicts Contraband delivery stopped by the siege
Cut stone (dressed blocks) printed with no Impaired mark while Stone quarry is depleted in LAND and Fortifications/Stone chains are impaired
Large-scale trading (largest event, distant merchants) printed unmarked here, but marked (stopped) in Institutions; Siege stops trade
Interment outside the gates printed unmarked; under Siege gates are closed and Institutions marks Burial (stopped)
Message relay (fresh horses at each station) unmarked; Institutions marks it (stopped) and the siege holds the roads
Caravan organization unmarked in Transportation; Institutions marks it (stopped) and Siege stops all road traffic
Horse hire for journeys unmarked; Institutions marks it (stopped); C1127 says no horses go out during the siege
Parcel forwarding between relay points unmarked; Institutions marks it (stopped) under siege
Route planning of roads for cargo unmarked; Institutions marks it (stopped) under siege
Credit letters honored across the trade network unmarked; Institutions marks Credit letters (stopped) under siege
Duties collected on all import and export goods unmarked; Institutions marks Duties and tariffs (stopped) under siege
Trade brokerage across regional markets unmarked; Institutions marks it (stopped) under siege
Says clergy have limited political leverage, but Religious Authorities is the strongest power (17), contests the seat, and C1613 says it makes the decisions that matter
Says ~6640 lbs/day short, but Food Security prints Short: 6,742 lbs/day (C1182)
Warden's family 'left last week'; under Siege gates are shut and nothing has gone in or out since it began (C1714)
Melane Hexamilites is (f) in PEOPLE but styled 'Merchant Prince', a male title; also printed at C1955
A master weaver (no rank) 'authorised an illegal sortie that failed'; C0105 says a sortie is only being considered and War Council leads defence
Chartermaster receives grain shipments by a covert route; FOOD brought in 0%, no food comes in by trade (C1183), nothing has come through the gates (C1714)
Potter has been digging clay from others' land; LAND gaps say Potter lacks access to clay and no clay reaches the potter
Says famine was caused by export decisions of Religious Authorities; page gives the siege and failed crops as the cause (C1758, C1761)
